meta.name: Balanced semiprimes · classical heuristic
meta.regime: No special polynomial form, partial factors or weak keys supplied
meta.rules: General-purpose NFS bound applied to RSA-type balanced semiprimes; no claim about concrete hardware timings. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
